titles.mr: शुभ उत्सव १.३.१ नवीन अपडेट उपलब्ध आहे! 🎉

releaseNotes.en:
• Enhanced GPS location with exact village/town detection
• Improved City Picker with smarter search & selection
• Better onboarding flow for new users
